strings.name: Bill Ackman
strings.role: Founder and CEO of Pershing Square
strings.summary: Bill Ackman is an American investor who founded Pershing Square. He uses concentrated holdings, fundamental research and shareholder activism to engage with listed companies' strategies. He is also executive chairman of Howard Hughes Holdings. His record includes gains and major setbacks; fund assets and returns are not his personal wealth.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026, with company documents dated November 2 as recent evidence. Founding in 2003 is distinguished from operations beginning in 2004, and the manager, funds and individual are kept separate. Only the verified birth year, 1966, is used.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Pershing Square and uses concentrated investing and shareholder activism to engage in the strategies of large listed companies.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: He earned a Harvard College AB in 1988 and a Harvard Business School MBA in 1992.
strings.facts.f2.label: Companies and funds
strings.facts.f2.value: Pershing Square Inc. is the asset manager's parent company. Pershing Square USA and Pershing Square Holdings are separate investment vehicles.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Concentrated investing and governance
strings.highlights.h1.text: He participates in corporate decisions through research, shareholdings and public shareholder campaigns. Investment performance reflects the team, company operations and market conditions.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Charitable foundation
strings.highlights.h2.text: He co-founded the Pershing Square Foundation in 2006, supporting health, education and innovation. Institutional commitments are not the same as amounts personally paid.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Joint shareholder letter published
strings.timeline.t1.text: The SEC filing confirms publication of a letter from Ackman and chief investment officer Ryan Israel alongside third-quarter results.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Two Pershing Square companies begin trading
strings.timeline.t2.text: Pershing Square Inc. and Pershing Square USA start trading on the New York Stock Exchange. The manager's parent and the fund are separately listed.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becomes Howard Hughes executive chairman
strings.timeline.t3.text: His appointment takes effect with the related transaction. A Pershing Square affiliate completes a $900 million share purchase; this is not recorded as his personal purchase.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Exits Herbalife investment
strings.timeline.t4.text: The annual report confirms the exit. The position detracted from that year's fund performance; the short campaign does not establish that allegations against the company were judicially proven.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Exits Valeant at a loss
strings.timeline.t5.text: The fund's annual report records the exit during the year, a loss-making episode in his investment career.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Pershing Square begins operations
strings.timeline.t6.text: The investment adviser's disclosure identifies 2004 as the start of operations, distinct from the earlier founding year.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founds Pershing Square
strings.timeline.t7.text: The current leadership biography dates the firm's founding and his CEO tenure to 2003.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Co-founds Gotham Partners
strings.timeline.t8.text: He begins co-managing the investment firm, an experience recorded as continuing until 2003.
